features.title: Intuitive Grid & Form Interface
features.description: Edit any record instantly with a dual grid/form system. No page navigation. Make corrections, updates, and changes seamlessly.
details: Built for efficiency. See all your records in a grid, click any row to edit in a side panel. No page navigation, no drilling through menus—just instant access to what you need.
Whether you're correcting a data entry mistake, updating ingredient information, or managing batch details, changes are immediate and seamless. This is what modern data management looks like.
Need to add to a Dropdown? Just click the '+' button, add it, and it's there!

features.title: Fast Batch Mapping
features.description:
Set up your business once, then:
• Create batches and manage ingredients in seconds.
• No drilling through menus.
details: - The old way? Drill through products or ingredients to add a batch.
- The new way? Three clicks: Product Type → Product → Batch. Then map your ingredients according to your recipe.

• No more navigating through multiple screens.
• Your recipe appears automatically, showing exactly which ingredients go into this batch.
• Click the map button in the Batch Choices grid. DONE!.

Ooops! Wrong mapping?
No problem. click the unmap button. DONE!
It's that simple.

features.title: Complete Ingredient Traceability
features.description: Track any ingredient through every product it touched. Critical for recalls and FDA compliance.
details: Need to trace an ingredient through your entire production? Whatfresh shows you instantly!

• Forward tracing: Pick any ingredient batch, see every Product Batch it went into
• Recall ready: In seconds, know exactly which batches and products are affected
• Complete audit trail: FSMA lot codes, dates, locations, supplier information all linked
For FDA compliance and recalls, this isn't just helpful—it's essential. Whatfresh makes it instant.

features.title: Print-Ready Production Worksheets
features.description: Generate compliance-ready documentation instantly. Everything your team needs in one place.
details: After mapping your ingredients, generate a complete batch worksheet in one click. It includes:

• Batch details (date, location, quantity)
• Complete ingredient list with batch IDs (full traceability)
• Task assignments and who's responsible for each step
• Ready to print for production floor
What used to require pulling information from multiple screens is now one coherent document!

features.title: Shopping Trips
features.description: Plan the run, print the list, then record every lot you bought in one place: one store, one day.
details: You buy ingredients in trips, so record them that way. Pick the store and the date, and everything you bought there lives together.
Before you go: add what you need to the shopping list (just the ingredient) and print it. The list is grouped by type and shows what you paid last time, so price jumps stand out.

When you get back: click each item and record the batch number, quantity, price and the supplier's lot code. Store and date are already filled in, and the last batch number for that ingredient is right there, so you always know what number comes next.

• Store only had part of a lot? Add a second lot for the same ingredient in one click.
• Print a receipt of the whole trip, lot by lot, with the total spent.
• Every purchase is a full ingredient batch, ready for batch mapping and recalls.
Less typing, nothing missed, and a record an inspector can follow.

features.title: Recall-Ready
features.description: Start from the ingredient lot, see every batch it went into, and know exactly which customers to call.
details: A supplier calls about a bad lot. With WhatsFresh you start from that ingredient lot and see every product batch it went into, with the supplier and the date you received it at the top.
Who got it? Record which customers received each product batch as you ship. When it counts, the list is already there.
One report, in the right order: customers to notify first, then the product batches and shipments, then your recall plan. Read it on screen or print it.
Your written recall plan: fill in a few blanks (your coordinator, a backup, where your sales records are kept) and print a plan you can keep on hand or show an inspector.
Practice before it's real: run a practice drill on any lot, so the first time you do a recall isn't the day it matters.
